eventPort.stateResync: urlChange/titleChange sequence gaps are repaired by the get-webview-url/get-webview-title (value, seq) query pair
eventPort.edgeRetry: extension-owned bounded retry (FIFO, 64 records) flushed on the next producer callback or after the next handled command; never blocks a native callback
eventPort.legacyFallback: without an attached port, migrated families ride the command-response outbox flush (H0 host compatibility)
